viewing_check: Weigh it (it decides the max; read off the scale in doubts). Find the 9ct/375 stamp inside the shank. Look at the opal side-on: a dark backing line and clear cap means triplet; check for cap scratches, lifting or cloudiness (water damage), and that all claws are tight. Note the size.
